headline: On November 13, 1996: Joel Armengaud finds first GIMPS Mersenne prime
captionCards: Sparked a worldwide volunteer search for giant primes
instagramCaption:
Joel Armengaud discovers a Mersenne prime.

He found 2^1398269−1 through the Great Internet Mersenne Prime Search. The number has 420,921 digits. It was the project’s first such prime ever identified.

This milestone launched a global volunteer effort to find massive primes using free software.
